alexcrichton opened PR #14583 from alexcrichton:try-fix to bytecodealliance:main:

This is a random stab in the dark at trying to fix [this spurious failure][fail] by seeing if localhost:N does things with IPv6 or something like that. In theory self.addr.to_string() should remove that ambiguity. No idea if this'll fix things, and no real way to confirm...

[fail]: https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasmtime/actions/runs/37512004700/job/112435414646
